<b>Scared Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are one of the few hardy pilgrims to have reached [[the Citadel]], found resting in [[Songclave]].

== In-game Events ==
Scared Pilgrim can be found in Songclave during [[Act 2]]. They lament the state of the rest of the Citadel, but are grateful for the sanctuary that [[Bellshrine|First Shrine]] provides.

Once their dialogue has been exhausted, they have a 25% chance of being gone the next time Hornet reenters Songclave after resting elsewhere. If they leave, they remain absent for the rest of the game.

== Location ==
Scared Pilgrim can be found near the [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] in Songclave in Act 2.
